recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups flour
2 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
1 ripe banana, mashed
Butter or oil for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, melted butter, and mashed banana.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined (a few lumps are fine).
Heat a lightly greased skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; flip once bubbles form on top and edges look set, about 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with syrup or extra banana slices.

recipes.title: Veggie Scrambled Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup milk
1/2 bell pepper, diced
1/4 onion, diced
1/2 cup spinach, chopped
1/4 cup shredded cheddar
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat and sauté onion and pepper until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, 1 minute.
Pour in eggs and gently push them across the pan with a spatula until just set.
Fold in cheese off the heat and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rolled oats
1 1/4 cups milk
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp honey or maple syrup
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
3/4 cup mixed berries
1 tbsp chia seeds
recipes.instructions:
Stir oats, milk, yogurt, honey, vanilla, and chia seeds together in a jar or container.
Divide into 3 individual jars if packing for work.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 6 hours.
Top with berries before eating; stir in a splash of milk if too thick.

recipes.title: Classic French Toast
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices thick bread (brioche or challah)
3 eggs
3/4 cup milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Pinch of salt
Butter for the pan
Maple syrup, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt in a shallow dish.
Dip each bread slice for a few seconds per side, letting it soak in without falling apart.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook slices 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve hot with maple syrup and fruit.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
recipes.ingredients:
3 slices sturdy bread, toasted
1 1/2 ripe avocados
1 tbsp lemon juice
3 eggs
Salt, pepper, and chili flakes
Olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fry or poach the eggs to your liking.
Spread avocado on toast, top each with an egg, and finish with chili flakes and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups Greek yogurt
1/3 cup granola
1 cup mixed berries
2 tbsp honey
recipes.instructions:
Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in glasses or bowls.
Drizzle with honey and serve right away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.title: Cheesy Vegetable Omelet
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup milk
1/2 cup mushrooms, sliced
1/2 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup diced tomato
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper together.
Sauté mushrooms in butter over medium heat until browned, about 4 minutes; remove and set aside.
Pour eggs into the same pan, let set slightly, then add mushrooms, tomato, and cheese to one half.
Fold the omelet over the filling and slide onto plates.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
3/4 cup sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
2 eggs
1/2 cup melted butter
3/4 cup milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups blueberries
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla.
Fold wet into dry until just combined, then fold in blueberries.
Divide batter among cups and bake 20-22 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.notes: Makes 9 muffins; freezes well for grab-and-go breakfasts.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/2 cup black beans, drained
1/2 cup cooked breakfast sausage or chorizo, crumbled
1/2 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup salsa
3 large flour tortillas
1 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Scramble eggs in oil over medium heat until just set.
Warm sausage and black beans in a separate pan.
Lay tortillas flat, fill with eggs, sausage, beans, cheese, and salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Wrap individually in foil to reheat later, or eat right away.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Baked Oatmeal
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1/3 cup brown sugar
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 3/4 cups milk
1 egg
3 tbsp melted butter
1/2 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and grease a small baking dish.
Mix oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter, then stir into the oat mixture with raisins.
Pour into the dish and bake 30-35 minutes until set and golden on top.
Cool slightly, slice into squares, and reheat individual portions through the week.

recipes.title: Breakfast Potato Hash
recipes.ingredients:
4 medium potatoes, diced
1/2 onion, diced
1/2 bell pepper, diced
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp paprika
Salt and pepper
3 fried eggs, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add potatoes in a single layer.
Cook, stirring occasionally, 12-15 minutes until tender and browned.
Add onion, pepper, paprika, salt, and pepper; cook 5 more minutes until vegetables soften.
Top each portion with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
recipes.ingredients:
2 bananas
2 tbsp peanut butter
1 1/2 cups milk
1 cup ice
1 tbsp honey (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth, adding a splash more milk if too thick.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Waffles
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
1 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
2 eggs, separated
1 1/2 cups milk
1/3 cup melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Preheat waffle iron.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Beat egg yolks with milk and melted butter; stir into dry ingredients.
Whip egg whites to soft peaks and gently fold in.
Cook in the waffle iron according to its instructions until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
1 bell pepper, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
5 eggs
Salt and pepper
Fresh parsley, chopped
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet and sauté onion and pepper until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5-6 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still soft.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.ingredients:
4 eggs, scrambled
3 small flour tortillas
3/4 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup salsa, plus more to serve
1 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Sprinkle cheese and scrambled eggs on half of each tortilla, fold over.
Melt a little butter in a skillet and cook each quesadilla 2 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Sausage and Cheese Breakfast Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
3 English muffins, split
3 breakfast sausage patties
3 eggs
3 slices cheese
Salt and pepper
Butter for toasting
recipes.instructions:
Cook sausage patties according to package directions until browned through.
Fry eggs in a small ring or lid so they're muffin-sized; season with salt and pepper.
Toast the English muffins with a little butter.
Stack muffin, sausage, egg, and cheese; wrap individually in foil to reheat later in the week.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese
3 eggs
1/2 cup flour
1 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp baking powder
Butter for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Blend cottage cheese and eggs until mostly smooth.
Whisk in flour, sugar, and baking powder until just combined.
Cook small pancakes in a buttered skillet over medium heat, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with fruit or a light drizzle of syrup.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rolled oats
3 cups milk or water
1 apple, diced
1 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp brown sugar or maple syrup
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Bring milk to a simmer in a saucepan.
Stir in oats, apple, cinnamon, and salt; cook 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Sweeten with brown sugar or maple syrup and serve warm.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Breakfast Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices bread, cubed
1 cup diced ham
1 cup shredded cheddar
6 eggs
1 1/2 cups milk
1 tsp mustard powder
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Grease a baking dish and layer in bread cubes, ham, and half the cheese.
Whisk eggs, milk, mustard powder, salt, and pepper; pour over the bread mixture.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350F, top with remaining cheese, and bake 40-45 minutes until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Homemade Granola
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups rolled oats
1/2 cup chopped nuts
1/3 cup honey or maple syrup
1/4 cup oil
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup dried fruit
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325F and line a baking sheet.
Toss oats, nuts, cinnamon, and salt together, then stir in honey and oil until evenly coated.
Spread onto the sheet and bake 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Cool completely, then stir in dried fruit and store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Egg White Veggie Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
8 egg whites
2 whole eggs
1/2 cup diced bell pepper
1/2 cup chopped spinach
1/4 cup diced onion
1/4 cup shredded cheese
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk egg whites and whole eggs with salt and pepper.
Divide vegetables and cheese among muffin cups, then pour egg mixture over each.
Bake 18-20 minutes until set and lightly golden.
Cool slightly before removing; refrigerate and reheat individually for quick work breakfasts.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Stuffed Bagels
recipes.ingredients:
3 bagels, split and toasted
6 tbsp cream cheese
1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced
Everything bagel seasoning
recipes.instructions:
Spread cream cheese on both halves of each toasted bagel.
Layer cucumber slices on top and sprinkle with everything seasoning.
Sandwich together and serve.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked corned beef, diced
3 medium potatoes, diced and parboiled
1/2 onion, diced
2 tbsp oil
Salt and pepper
3 fried eggs, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add potatoes; cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and corned beef; cook, pressing down occasionally, until crisp in spots, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and top each serving with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Yogurt Breakfast Bowls with Honey and Nuts
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups Greek yogurt
3 tbsp honey
1/3 cup chopped walnuts or almonds
1 cup sliced fruit (peach, banana, or berries)
recipes.instructions:
Divide yogurt among bowls.
Top with honey, nuts, and sliced fruit.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices bacon
6 slices bread, toasted
6 oz sliced turkey breast
3 leaves lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
3 tbsp mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Cook bacon until crisp; drain on paper towels.
Spread mayonnaise on toasted bread.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato between slices.
Cut in half and pack or serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 boneless chicken breasts
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
1 large romaine lettuce, chopped
1/2 cup croutons
1/3 cup shredded parmesan
1/3 cup Caesar dressing
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and cook in olive oil over medium heat, 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Slice chicken once rested.
Toss lettuce with dressing, croutons, and parmesan.
Top with sliced chicken and serve.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 cucumber, diced
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/2 red onion, diced
1/3 cup crumbled feta
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and feta in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper; pour over salad and toss.
Portion into containers — this keeps well in the fridge for 3-4 days.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp butter
1/2 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 cup vegetable broth
1/2 cup cream
6 slices bread
6 slices cheddar or American cheese
Butter for grilling
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter and sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth (or leave chunky) and stir in cream.
Meanwhile, butter bread on the outsides, add cheese, and grill in a skillet until golden and melted, about 3 minutes per side.
Serve sandwiches alongside bowls of soup.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Wraps
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (5 oz) tuna, drained
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 celery stalk, diced
2 tbsp red onion, diced
1 tbsp lemon juice
Salt and pepper
3 large tortillas
Lettuce leaves
recipes.instructions:
Mix tuna, mayonnaise, celery, onion, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Lay tortillas flat, add lettuce and tuna salad.
Roll tightly, slice in half, and pack for lunch.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 tbsp oil
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup mixed frozen vegetables
2 green onions, sliced
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
recipes.instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok and scramble the eggs; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry vegetables until tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add rice, breaking up clumps, and cook 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Stir in eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions; toss to combine.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
6 cups chicken broth
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
1 1/2 cups egg noodles
Salt, pepper, and fresh thyme
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, 6-7 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in noodles and cook 8-10 minutes until tender.
Add shredded chicken, season with salt, pepper, and thyme, and heat through.

recipes.title: Caprese Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 baguette or ciabatta, sliced into 3 portions
8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
2 tomatoes, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
3 tbsp pesto or olive oil
Balsamic glaze
recipes.instructions:
Spread pesto or drizzle olive oil on bread.
Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and close sandwiches.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
3 cups broccoli florets
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
2 tbsp oil
3 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Toss steak with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch; let sit 10 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry beef until browned, 2-3 minutes; remove.
Add remaining oil, garlic, and ginger, then broccoli; stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the pan, add remaining soy sauce and oyster sauce, and toss to coat.
Serve over rice; portions reheat well for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Southwest Quinoa Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup quinoa, rinsed
2 cups vegetable broth
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 cup corn kernels
1 avocado, diced
1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/3 cup chopped cilantro
Juice of 1 lime
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Cook quinoa in vegetable broth according to package directions; let cool slightly.
Toss quinoa with black beans, corn, tomatoes, and cilantro.
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper; drizzle over the bowl.
Top with avocado just before eating; keeps well without avocado for meal prep.

recipes.title: Ham and Swiss Panini
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices sourdough bread
6 oz sliced deli ham
6 slices Swiss cheese
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
Butter for grilling
recipes.instructions:
Spread mustard on bread, layer ham and cheese, and close sandwiches.
Butter the outsides and grill in a panini press or skillet with a weight on top, 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups dried brown or green lentils, rinsed
6 cups vegetable broth
1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes
1 tsp cumin
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cumin; cook 1 minute.
Add lentils, broth, and tomatoes; bring to a boil, then simmer 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper; blend a portion for a creamier texture if desired.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups chopped romaine
2 chicken breasts, cooked and diced
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1 avocado, diced
1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/3 cup crumbled blue cheese
Vinaigrette dressing
recipes.instructions:
Arrange lettuce in bowls or a platter.
Top with rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomatoes, and blue cheese.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: Falafel Pita Wraps
recipes.ingredients:
12 frozen or homemade falafel patties
3 pita breads
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 tomato, diced
1/2 cucumber, diced
1/2 cup tzatziki or tahini sauce
recipes.instructions:
Cook falafel according to package directions until hot and crisp.
Warm pitas slightly and fill with lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
Add falafel and drizzle with tzatziki or tahini before folding closed.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 celery stalk, diced
2 tbsp dried cranberries
1 tbsp chopped pecans
Salt and pepper
6 slices bread
recipes.instructions:
Mix chicken, mayonnaise, celery, cranberries, pecans, salt, and pepper.
Divide between bread slices to make sandwiches.
Chicken salad keeps in the fridge for 3-4 days for quick lunches.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes
5 cups vegetable broth
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 cup small pasta
2 cups chopped kale or spinach
Parmesan, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, tomatoes, and broth; bring to a boil.
Stir in pasta and beans; simmer 10-12 minutes until pasta is tender.
Add kale and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted; season to taste.
Serve topped with parmesan.

recipes.title: BLT Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
9 slices bacon
6 slices bread, toasted
3 leaves lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
3 tbsp mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Cook bacon until crisp.
Spread mayonnaise on toast and layer lettuce, tomato, and bacon.
Slice and serve, or wrap for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Pita Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
2 chicken breasts, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp oregano
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper
1 1/2 cups cooked rice
1 cucumber, diced
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/3 cup crumbled feta
1/3 cup tzatziki sauce
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Layer rice, chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, and feta in containers.
Top with tzatziki just before eating.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
6 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 celery stalk, diced
Salt and pepper
6 slices bread
recipes.instructions:
Mix eggs, mayonnaise, mustard, celery, salt, and pepper.
Spread on bread to make sandwiches, or serve on lettuce for a lower-carb option.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 large potatoes, peeled and diced
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup milk
1/2 cup cream
1/2 cup shredded cheddar, plus more to serve
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2 green onions, sliced
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Simmer potatoes in broth until fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Mash about half the potatoes right in the pot for a creamy-chunky texture.
Stir in milk, cream, and cheese until melted and smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Top each bowl with bacon, extra cheese, and green onions.

recipes.title: Hummus and Veggie Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 large tortillas
3/4 cup hummus
1 cup shredded carrots
1 cup baby spinach
1/2 cucumber, sliced thin
1/2 red bell pepper, sliced thin
recipes.instructions:
Spread hummus over each tortilla.
Layer carrots, spinach, cucumber, and bell pepper down the center.
Roll up tightly and slice in half for packing.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad with Italian Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups rotini pasta
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/2 cucumber, diced
1/2 cup black olives, sliced
1/3 cup diced red onion
1/2 cup mozzarella pearls
1/2 cup Italian dressing
recipes.instructions:
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and cool.
Toss pasta with tomatoes, cucumber, olives, onion, and mozzarella.
Add dressing and toss to coat; chill before serving. Keeps well for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Turkey and Avocado Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 large tortillas
6 oz sliced turkey breast
1 avocado, sliced
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/3 cup shredded cheese
3 tbsp ranch or mayo
recipes.instructions:
Spread ranch or mayo over tortillas.
Layer turkey, avocado, lettuce, and cheese.
Roll up tightly, slice in half, and pack.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1/2 onion, diced
3 tbsp flour
2 cups milk
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
4 cups broccoli florets, chopped small
2 cups shredded cheddar
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter and sauté onion until soft, 4 minutes.
Whisk in flour and cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in milk and broth.
Add broccoli and simmer 12-15 minutes until tender.
Reduce heat to low, stir in cheese until melted, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup red wine (optional)
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp dried basil
Salt and pepper
12 oz spaghetti
Parmesan, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, 7-8 minutes.
Add garlic and ground beef; cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Pour in wine, if using, and simmer 2 minutes to cook off the alcohol.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, and basil; season with salt and pepper.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions; toss with sauce and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken with Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (about 4 lb)
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp fresh thyme or 1 tsp dried
Salt and pepper
1 lemon, halved
4 potatoes, quartered
3 carrots, cut into chunks
1 onion, quartered
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Pat chicken dry, rub with olive oil, thyme, salt, and pepper, and stuff the cavity with lemon.
Arrange potatoes, carrots, and onion around the chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast 70-80 minutes until the chicken reaches 165F internally and vegetables are tender, basting once halfway through.
Rest the chicken 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced thin
2 tbsp cornstarch
3 tbsp soy sauce, divided
2 tbsp oil
2 cups broccoli florets
1 bell pepper, sliced
1 carrot, sliced thin
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
Cooked rice, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry chicken until cooked through; remove.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry broccoli, pepper, and carrot until crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 30 seconds.
Return chicken to the pan with remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil; toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 packet (or 2 tbsp) taco seasoning
2/3 cup water
9 taco shells or small tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded cheese
1 tomato, diced
Sour cream and salsa, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat, add taco seasoning and water, and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Warm taco shells or tortillas.
Fill with beef and top with lettuce, cheese, tomato, sour cream, and salsa.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Dill
recipes.ingredients:
3 salmon fillets (about 6 oz each)
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon, sliced
1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet.
Place salmon on the sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with garlic, salt, and pepper.
Top each fillet with lemon slices and dill.
Bake 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Vegetable Curry
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
2 tbsp curry powder
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes
2 potatoes, diced
1 cup cauliflower florets
1 cup green beans, trimmed
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained
Salt, to taste
Cooked rice, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in coconut milk and diced tomatoes, then add potatoes and cauliflower.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add green beans and chickpeas; cook 5-8 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup milk
1 egg
1/2 onion, diced
2 tbsp ketchup, plus 1/4 cup for topping
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper
4 potatoes, peeled and cubed
1/4 cup butter
1/4 cup milk (for potatoes)
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F.
Mix beef, breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup milk, egg, onion, 2 tbsp ketchup, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.
Shape into a loaf in a baking dish, top with remaining ketchup, and bake 55-60 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, boil potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes; drain and mash with butter and milk, seasoning to taste.
Rest meatloaf 5 minutes before slicing; serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz linguine
1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined
4 tbsp butter
2 tbsp olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
1/2 cup white wine or chicken broth
Juice of 1 lemon
1/4 cup chopped parsley
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Cook linguine according to package directions; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet; sauté garlic and red pepper flakes 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink; remove.
Add wine and lemon juice, simmer 2 minutes, then whisk in remaining butter.
Toss in pasta, shrimp, and parsley, adding pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples
recipes.ingredients:
3 bone-in pork chops
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp butter
2 apples, sliced
1/2 onion, sliced
2 tbsp brown sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear chops 4-5 minutes per side; remove and rest.
Add remaining butter, apples, and onion; cook 6-7 minutes until softened.
Stir in brown sugar, cinnamon, and broth; simmer 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return chops to the pan to warm through and serve topped with apples.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
1 bell pepper, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 cup corn kernels
1 cup vegetable broth
Salt and pepper
Shredded cheese and sour cream, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and sauté onion and pepper until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, beans, corn, and broth; bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and serve topped with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Roasted Chicken Thighs
recipes.ingredients:
6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
3 tbsp olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
Juice and zest of 1 lemon
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Whisk olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, zest, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss chicken thighs in the mixture and arrange skin-side up in a baking dish.
Roast 30-35 minutes until skin is crisp and internal temperature reaches 165F.

recipes.title: Beef Stir-Fried Noodles
recipes.ingredients:
10 oz lo mein or spaghetti noodles
1 lb flank steak, sliced thin
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp oil
2 cups mixed vegetables (cabbage, carrot, bell pepper)
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
Toss steak with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and stir-fry beef until browned; remove.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry vegetables and garlic until crisp-tender, 3-4 minutes.
Return beef and noodles to the pan with remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil; toss well.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.ingredients:
3 large bell peppers, halved and seeded
1 lb ground beef or turkey
1 cup cooked rice
1/2 onion, diced
1 cup tomato sauce, divided
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 cup shredded mozzarella
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Brown beef with onion; drain fat.
Stir in rice, half the tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Fill pepper halves with the mixture, place in a baking dish, and top with remaining tomato sauce.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover, top with cheese, and bake 10 more minutes until melted.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb white fish fillets (cod or tilapia)
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp chili powder
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp oil
9 small corn tortillas
1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage
1/2 cup sour cream
1 tbsp lime juice
Salsa and cilantro, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Season fish with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook fish 3-4 minutes per side until flaky; break into chunks.
Mix sour cream with lime juice for a quick crema.
Warm tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, crema, salsa, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, halved horizontally
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated parmesan
2 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup flour
3 tbsp oil
2 cups marinara sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
12 oz spaghetti, cooked
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Dredge chicken in flour, then egg, then a mix of breadcrumbs and parmesan.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken 3 minutes per side; transfer to a baking dish.
Top with marinara and mozzarella; bake 15-18 minutes until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through.
Serve over spaghetti with extra marinara.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Kebabs
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef sirloin, cubed
1/4 cup olive oil
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 bell pepper, cut into chunks
1 red onion, cut into chunks
1 zucchini, sliced thick
recipes.instructions:
Whisk olive oil, soy sauce, garlic, and rosemary; marinate beef 30 minutes to overnight.
Thread beef and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill or broil, turning occasionally, 10-12 minutes until beef reaches desired doneness and vegetables are charred.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp butter
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp fresh thyme
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through; remove.
Add mushrooms and cook until browned, about 6 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in broth, scraping up any browned bits, then stir in cream and thyme; simmer 3-4 minutes to thicken.
Return chicken to the pan to coat in sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
recipes.ingredients:
9 lasagna noodles
2 tbsp olive oil
1 zucchini, diced
1 cup mushrooms, sliced
1 cup spinach, chopped
2 cups ricotta cheese
1 egg
3 cups marinara sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.
Sauté zucchini and mushrooms in olive oil until softened; add spinach and cook until wilted.
Mix ricotta with egg and a pinch of salt.
Layer noodles, marinara, ricotta mixture, vegetables, and mozzarella in a baking dish, repeating twice more.
Top with remaining sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 15-20 more minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Salmon
recipes.ingredients:
3 salmon fillets
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp oil
Sesame seeds and green onion, to garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and rice vinegar.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear salmon skin-side up 3-4 minutes.
Flip, pour sauce over, and cook 4-5 minutes, spooning sauce over the top, until salmon is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced thin
2 bell peppers, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 tbsp oil
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
Salt and pepper
9 small flour tortillas
Sour cream, salsa, and lime, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with half the oil and spices.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and cook chicken until browned and cooked through, about 6-7 minutes; remove.
Add remaining oil and cook peppers and onion until charred and tender, 6-7 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan and toss together.
Serve with warm tortillas, sour cream, salsa, and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ziti pasta
1 lb Italian sausage or ground beef
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and cook ziti until just under al dente; drain.
Brown sausage with onion and garlic; drain fat and stir in marinara sauce.
Combine pasta with sauce and ricotta; pour half into a baking dish.
Top with half the mozzarella, add remaining pasta, then remaining mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/3 cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
3 cups cooked rice
2 cups steamed broccoli
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger.
Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Add sauce and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until glossy and thickened.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli; great for reheating as work lunches too.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
1 onion, quartered
4 cloves garlic
1 orange, juiced
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
Salt and pepper
1 cup chicken broth
Tortillas, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Season pork with cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place pork, onion, garlic, orange juice, and broth in a slow cooker or Dutch oven.
Cook on low 6-8 hours (slow cooker) or braise covered at 300F for 3 hours until pork shreds easily.
Shred pork and, if desired, crisp under the broiler for a few minutes.
Serve in tortillas with your favorite taco toppings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto Shrimp
recipes.ingredients:
3 medium zucchini, spiralized
1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup basil pesto
1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
Salt and pepper
Grated parmesan, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink; remove.
Add zucchini noodles and tomatoes to the pan; cook 2-3 minutes until just tender.
Toss zucchini with pesto and return shrimp to the pan to warm through.
Season with salt and pepper and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1/2 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
1/3 cup flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup milk
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
1 cup frozen peas
1 sheet puff pastry or pie crust
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Melt butter and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in broth and milk until thickened.
Add chicken, peas, salt, and pepper; pour into a baking dish.
Top with pastry, cutting a few slits for steam, and bake 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Sesame Ginger Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.ingredients:
14 oz firm tofu, pressed and cubed
2 tbsp cornstarch
3 tbsp oil
2 cups broccoli florets
1 carrot, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp sesame oil
Cooked rice, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Toss tofu cubes with cornstarch.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet and fry tofu until golden on most sides, about 8 minutes; remove.
Add remaining oil and stir-fry broccoli and carrot until crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 30 seconds.
Return tofu to the pan with soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil; toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck, cubed
3 tbsp flour
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 carrots, sliced
3 potatoes, cubed
2 celery stalks, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
4 cups beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme
2 bay leaves
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef with flour, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef in batches; remove.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Return beef to the pot with broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours, adding potatoes for the last 30 minutes, until beef is fork-tender.
Discard bay leaves and season to taste before serving.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb pizza dough
1/2 cup pizza or marinara sauce
8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and red pepper flakes
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 475F with a pizza stone or baking sheet inside.
Stretch dough into a round on parchment paper.
Spread sauce, leaving a border, and top with mozzarella.
Slide onto the hot stone or sheet and bake 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbles.
Top with fresh basil, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and red pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb sirloin steak, cubed
1 lb baby potatoes, halved and parboiled
4 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh rosemary or thyme
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Season steak with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat and sear steak bites 2-3 minutes until browned; remove.
Add potatoes to the same pan and cook until crisp and golden, about 8 minutes.
Add butter, garlic, and herbs; return steak to the pan and toss until coated and fragrant, about 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cubed
1 cup plain yogurt
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp garam masala, divided
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 cup cream
Salt, to taste
Cooked rice or naan, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, and half the garam masala for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pan and cook chicken until browned and cooked through; remove.
In the same pan, sauté onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, and remaining garam masala; cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then stir in cream and return chicken to the pan.
Simmer 5-8 minutes until sauce thickens; season with salt and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: One-Pan Sausage and Peppers
recipes.ingredients:
6 Italian sausage links
2 bell peppers, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Salt and pepper
3 hoagie rolls (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and brown sausages on all sides, about 8 minutes; remove.
Add peppers and onion to the pan with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Slice sausages and return to the pan to finish cooking through, 3-4 minutes.
Serve as is or stuffed into hoagie rolls.

recipes.title: Black Bean Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
9 corn tortillas
2 cans (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 cup corn kernels
1 cup diced bell pepper
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups shredded cheese
Sour cream and cilantro, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Mix black beans, corn, bell pepper, and 1/2 cup enchilada sauce.
Warm tortillas slightly so they roll without cracking, fill with bean mixture, and roll up in a baking dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly; top with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Herb Pork Tenderloin
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
3 tbsp olive oil
Juice of 1 lemon
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh rosemary, chopped
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper; marinate pork at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill or a grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill pork, turning occasionally, 18-20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Risotto
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups vegetable broth
2 tbsp olive oil
1 small onion, diced
1 1/2 cups arborio rice
1/2 cup white wine (optional)
2 cups cubed butternut squash
1/2 cup grated parmesan
2 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper
Fresh sage, chopped
recipes.instructions:
Keep broth warm in a saucepan over low heat.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion until soft, about 4 minutes; add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add wine, if using, and stir until absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting for it to absorb before adding more, about 20 minutes; add squash halfway through.
When rice is creamy and squash is tender, stir in parmesan and butter; season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with sage.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
3 lb pork shoulder
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper
1 1/2 cups BBQ sauce
6 burger buns
Coleslaw, to serve
recipes.instructions:
Rub pork with brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Place in a slow cooker with 1/2 cup BBQ sauce and cook on low 8 hours (or braise covered at 300F for 3 1/2 to 4 hours) until shreddable.
Shred pork and mix with remaining BBQ sauce.
Pile onto buns and top with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Hummus with Veggie Sticks
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups hummus
2 carrots, cut into sticks
2 celery stalks, cut into sticks
1 cucumber, sliced
1 bell pepper, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Arrange vegetables on a plate or in containers around a bowl of hummus.
Serve immediately or pack in individual containers for the week.

recipes.title: Trail Mix
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup mixed nuts
1/2 cup pretzels or crackers
1/2 cup dried fruit
1/2 cup chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Divide into small bags or containers for grab-and-go snacking.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese Quesadilla Wedges
recipes.ingredients:
3 small tortillas
1 cup shredded cheese
1 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Sprinkle cheese over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook quesadillas 2 minutes per side until crisp and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
recipes.ingredients:
3 apples, sliced
6 tbsp peanut butter
Cinnamon, for sprinkling
recipes.instructions:
Arrange apple slices on a plate.
Serve with peanut butter for dipping and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Homemade Popcorn with Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup popcorn kernels
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp melted butter
1/4 cup grated parmesan
Salt, to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat, add a few kernels, and cover.
Once they pop, add remaining kernels, cover, and shake occasionally until popping slows.
Toss popped corn with melted butter, parmesan, and salt.

recipes.title: No-Bake Energy Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/3 cup honey
1/2 cup mini chocolate chips
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 tbsp chia seeds
recipes.instructions:
Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined.
Roll into 1-inch balls and place on a lined tray.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes to firm up; store in the fridge for grab-and-go snacks.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp vinegar
Salt and pepper
Paprika, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Boil eggs 11-12 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Halve eggs and scoop yolks into a bowl; mash with mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the egg whites and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Cheese and Cracker Snack Boxes
recipes.ingredients:
6 oz sliced cheese, cubed
1 cup whole grain crackers
1 cup grapes
1/2 cup almonds
recipes.instructions:
Divide cheese, crackers, grapes, and almonds into small containers.
Refrigerate until ready to pack for work or school.

recipes.title: Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and dried well
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt, to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Toss chickpeas with oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast 25-30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crisp.
Cool before storing in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Mini Caprese Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
12 cherry tomatoes
12 mini mozzarella balls
12 basil leaves
2 tbsp olive oil
Balsamic glaze
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Thread a tomato, folded basil leaf, and mozzarella ball onto small skewers.
Arrange on a plate and drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp salt
1 cup butter, softened
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup brown sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 cups chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt.
Cream butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in dry ingredients until just combined, then fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets and bake 9-11 minutes until edges are golden.
recipes.notes: Makes about 18 cookies; dough freezes well for baking a few at a time.

recipes.title: Classic Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup butter, melted
1 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/3 cup cocoa powder
1/2 cup flour
1/4 tsp salt
1/4 tsp baking powder
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and line a small baking pan.
Whisk melted butter and sugar, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa powder, flour, salt, and baking powder until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out mostly clean.
Cool before slicing into squares.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Crisp
recipes.ingredients:
4 apples, peeled and sliced
1 tbsp lemon juice
1/3 cup sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
3/4 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup flour
1/3 cup brown sugar
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Toss apples with lemon juice, sugar, and cinnamon; spread in a baking dish.
Mix oats, flour, and brown sugar, then cut in butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle topping over apples and bake 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheesecake Cups
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup melted butter
16 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup whipped cream
1 cup fruit topping or berries
recipes.instructions:
Mix graham crumbs with melted butter and press into the bottoms of small cups.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until smooth, then fold in whipped cream.
Spoon over the crusts and chill at least 2 hours.
Top with fruit before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.ingredients:
3 ripe bananas, mashed
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp baking soda
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups flour
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and grease a loaf pan.
Mix mashed bananas with melted butter, then stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in, then fold in flour just until combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 50-55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 10 minutes before turning out.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup arborio or short-grain rice
3 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Pinch of salt
Raisins (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice, milk, sugar, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook, stirring often, 25-30 minutes until rice is tender and mixture has thickened.
Stir in vanilla and raisins, if using; sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1/4 cup powdered sugar, plus more for dusting
1/2 cup cold butter, cubed
2 eggs
1 cup sugar
1/3 cup lemon juice
2 tbsp flour (for filling)
1/2 tsp baking powder
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F.
Pulse 1 cup flour, powdered sugar, and butter until crumbly; press into a baking pan and bake 15 minutes.
Whisk eggs, sugar, lemon juice, 2 tbsp flour, and baking powder; pour over the hot crust.
Bake 20-25 more minutes until set.
Cool completely, dust with powdered sugar, and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup sugar
3 tbsp cornstarch
3 tbsp cocoa powder
Pinch of salt
2 1/2 cups milk
2 egg yolks
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Whisk sugar, cornstarch, cocoa, and salt in a saucepan.
Whisk in milk and egg yolks until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thickened and bubbling, about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and butter.
Pour into cups and chill before serving, or eat warm.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/4 cup sugar, plus 2 tbsp for berries
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup milk or cream
3 cups strawberries, sliced
1 cup whipped cream
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Whisk flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder, and salt; cut in butter until crumbly.
Stir in milk just until a soft dough forms.
Pat into a round, cut into wedges or biscuits, and bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Toss strawberries with remaining sugar and let sit 15 minutes to release juices.
Split biscuits, layer with strawberries and whipped cream.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup peanut butter
1 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp baking soda
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F.
Mix all ingredients together until a smooth dough forms.
Roll into balls, place on a baking sheet, and press with a fork to make a crosshatch pattern.
Bake 9-10 minutes until set; cool on the sheet a few minutes before moving.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream Sundaes
recipes.ingredients:
1 pint vanilla ice cream
1/2 cup chocolate or caramel sauce
1/3 cup chopped nuts
Whipped cream
3 maraschino cherries
recipes.instructions:
Scoop ice cream into bowls.
Top with sauce, nuts, whipped cream, and a cherry.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Cinnamon Sugar Donut Holes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 cup milk
1 egg
3 tbsp melted butter, plus more for coating
1/2 cup sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon, for coating
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and grease a mini muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter; stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
Fill muffin cups two-thirds full and bake 9-10 minutes until springy.
While warm, roll each donut hole in melted butter, then in cinnamon sugar.
